title: ashwingopalsamy/central-bank-policy-rates / cycles
description: Each run of consecutive moves in one direction since the policy-rate era began, computed exactly as on the site: a cycle starts with the first move after a move the other way.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

start_date.description: Effective date of the first move.

end_date.description: Effective date of the last move so far.

moves.description: Number of moves in the cycle.

total_bps.description: Signed total change from the rate before the cycle to its last move, in basis points.

days.description: Days from the first to the last move.

from_rate_pct.description: The rate before the cycle began (upper bound for a range).

to_rate_pct.description: The rate after the cycle’s last move.

is_current.description: True for the most recent cycle, which may still be running.
